{{Quote|You are head of the Pyramid of Ancient Knowledge. You are charged with keeping the mystical knowledge of the Sith, and guarding the secrets of our order.|[[Darth Marr]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Sphere of Ancient Knowledge''', also known as both the '''Pyramid of Ancient Knowledge''' and the '''Ministry of Ancient Knowledge''', was one of twelve [[Spheres of Influence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Headed by a [[Dark Council]]or, the Sphere was responsible for the protection and expansion of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] knowledge.

==History==
{{Quote|Purge this pyramid of any who are still loyal to Thanaton. They are traitors.|[[Darth Nox]] upon assuming leadership|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />}}
The Pyramid of Ancient Knowledge was a power base of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] responsible for guarding and research of ancient Sith knowledge. As with every other pyramid within the Empire, it was composed of many other power bases of Sith Lords, all vying to increase their own strength and standing amongst the Sith, though whichever power base they served or controlled, ultimately all in the pyramid answered the [[Dark Council]]or at its head.

Between [[3642 BBY]] and [[3640 BBY]], the pyramid had three successive leaders. After [[Darth Arctis]] [[Death/Legends|died]] in unknown circumstances, he was replaced by [[Darth Thanaton]]. But Thanaton's victory was short-lived as he lost his own [[Kaggath]] against his rival, Lord [[Darth Nox|Kallig]], who defeated him in front of the other members of the Dark Council and was put out of his misery by [[Darth Mortis]], head of the [[Sphere of Laws and Justice]]. Upon returning to [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], both Kallig's and Thanaton's allies and servants pledged allegiance to the new [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and Dark Councilor.

Later, on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], Darth Nox's lieutenant, [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Valion Pyron|Pyron]], briefed Nox on current military movements. He advised that Nox seek out Lord [[Veijel]], who believed he had found the means of granting the Darth eternal life. Though [[Talos Drellik]] advised against it, Nox granted Veijel resources to pursue their goal of eternal life.

Following the [[war against Zakuul]], [[Sith Emperor/Legends|Empress]] [[Darth Acina]] merged the Spheres of Influence into five new council seats, with the Sphere of Ancient Knowledge being consolidated alongside the [[Sphere of Mysteries|Spheres of Mysteries]] and [[Sphere of Sith Philosophy|Sith Philosophy]] into the [[Sphere of Sith Doctrine]]. Following the reform, [[Darth Anathel]] led the three spheres.<ref name="SOTG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Depending on the player's choices after ascending to the Dark Council, Darth Nox either had the sphere purged of Thanaton's supporters, ordered doubling of efforts to uncover lost Sith rituals and artifacts, or simply declared that the Sphere was to fight the Republic.<ref name="TDC">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Inquisitor|The Dark Council|Dromund Kaas}}</ref>

If the player spared [[Harkun]] and [[Darth Achelon|Achelon]], they would be present and bow before the Sphere's new leader. If Achelon was killed, [[Kirnon]] would take his place.<ref name="TDC" />

If Darth Nox kills Darth Anathel and rejoins the Sith Empire, they will be Head of the Sphere of Ancient Knowledge once again, the Sphere now being called Sith Doctrine.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|Objective Meridian|Vaiken Spacedock}}</ref>
